subject: Matemática
description_pt: Associar prismas e pirâmides a suas planificações e analisar, nomear e comparar seus atributos, estabelecendo relações entre as representações planas e espaciais.

components.description_pt: Relacionar um prisma dado à sua planificação correspondente
components.description_en: Match a given prism to its corresponding net

components.description_pt: Comparar e descrever atributos de prismas e pirâmides
components.description_en: Compare and describe attributes of prisms and pyramids
components.cc_component_description: Compare three-dimensional shapes in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts, and other attributes

components.description_pt: Estabelecer relações entre planificações bidimensionais e suas figuras tridimensionais
components.description_en: Establish relationships between two-dimensional nets and their three-dimensional figures
components.cc_component_description: Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles

cc_matches.description: Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.

Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).
